Automated Data Extraction
Take the Browser Copilot one step further by adding scraping capabilities.

How it works: Uses Beautiful Soup + Playwright to extract structured data.
Commands: "Go to Amazon, search for laptops under $1000, and save the top 10 results to a CSV on my desktop."

Ghost Cursor (Precision OS Control)
How it works: We divide your screen into a grid numerically (like a grid overlay). We use PyAutoGUI to give MARK absolute control over your physical mouse cursor.
Commands: "MARK, move mouse to the top right and click the volume icon." or "Scroll down fast."

Instant Local Dictation (Lightning Fast)
How it works: We integrate a tiny Whisper.cpp model entirely locally. When you hold a specific key combination (e.g., Command+Space), MARK instantly types whatever you say directly into whatever app you have open, much faster and more accurately than macOS's built-in dictation.

Spotlight-Style Floating Command Palette

What it is: You never have to open the MARK browser tab again. Hitting a hotkey (like Option + Space) summons a glassmorphic, floating search bar directly in the center of your Mac screen (built using PyQt6 or similar overlay tech).
Why it’s cool: Type a command silently and hit Enter. The bar vanishes instantly, and MARK executes the task in the background.

FastAPI / Asyncio Architecture Rewrite

What it is: We upgrade the core server from Flask (synchronous) to FastAPI (fully asynchronous).
Why it’s fast: Currently, if MARK is running a massive Universal Search, other background tasks might bottleneck. With asyncio, MARK can run web research, file searching, UI updates, and TTS audio generation concurrently at the exact same time without blocking.
